ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: Banksy's New Work in Port Talbot

fullPassage:
Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a dumpster fire.
Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant.
Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in toxic air every day. In 2016, the WHO even estimated that about 600,000 children died from exposure to polluted air.
Banksy's art has included environmental messages before. For example, his 2010 artwork was created at the remains of a plant in Detroit. It showed a child with a can of red paint and the words, "I remember when all this was trees."

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy ①<u>designed</u> another interesting piece of art, which ②<u>appears</u> on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child ③<u>catching</u> snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash ④<u>came</u> from a dumpster fire.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 쓰레기통 불에서 나오는 재.
det.analysis: ✅ ①designed: 과거형 정상. ✅ ②appears: 주격관계대명사 which + 단수동사. ✅ ③catching: a child catching(현재분사) 정상. ❌ ④came: ash coming from(현재분사). 명사 ash를 수식하는 분사 필요.
det.tip: 현재분사 coming: 명사를 뒤에서 수식. ash coming from = ~에서 나오는 재.

questions.passage: Banksy was ①<u>asked</u> by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that ②<u>would</u> highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children ③<u>were facing</u> serious health risks by ④<u>play</u> in the dust coming from the local steel plant.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 먼지 속에서 놀면서 건강 위험에 직면.
det.analysis: ✅ ①asked: was asked(수동태) 정상. ✅ ②would: 시제일치(과거의 미래) 정상. ✅ ③were facing: 과거진행형 정상. ❌ ④play: by + V-ing. by playing이 맞음.
det.tip: 전치사 by + V-ing (O) / by + V원형 (X). by playing = ~하면서.

questions.passage: Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more ①<u>pollutants</u>. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 ②<u>breathe</u> in toxic air every day. In 2016, the WHO even ③<u>estimated</u> that about 600,000 children ④<u>dying</u> from exposure to polluted air.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 약 60만 명의 아이들이 오염된 공기에 노출되어 사망했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①pollutants: 명사 정상. ✅ ②breathe: 복수주어 children + 복수동사. ✅ ③estimated: 과거형 정상. ❌ ④dying: that절 내 주어 children의 본동사 필요. died가 맞음.
det.tip: that절 안에 주어+동사 필요. children died(과거형) (O) / children dying(분사) (X).

questions.passage: Banksy's art has included environmental messages before. For example, his 2010 artwork was ①<u>created</u> at the remains of a plant in Detroit. It showed a child with a can of red paint and the words, "I ②<u>remember</u> when all this ③<u>was</u> trees." Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, ④<u>who</u> appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 콘크리트 블록 차고에 나타나는 예술 작품 — 사물이므로 which.
det.analysis: ✅ ①created: was created(수동태) 정상. ✅ ②remember: 1인칭 현재 정상. ✅ ③was: all this(단수 취급) 정상. ❌ ④who: 선행사 piece of art(사물) → which가 맞음. who는 사람에게만.
det.tip: who(사람) vs which(사물/동물). piece of art = 사물 → which.

questions.passage: Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in __________ air every day.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 세계 아동의 93%가 유독한 공기를 매일 마신다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②toxic: 원문 그대로. 오염물질 맥락. ❌ ①fresh(신선한): 반대. ❌ ③clean(깨끗한): 반대. ❌ ④warm(따뜻한): 무관.
det.tip: toxic: 유독한, 독성이 있는. air pollution → toxic air.

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching ①<u>snowflakes</u> with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ②<u>ash</u> coming from a dumpster fire. Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot ③<u>resident</u>, to create art that would ④<u>conceal</u> Port Talbot's dust problem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 먼지 문제를 부각(highlight)하기 위한 예술. conceal(숨기다)은 부적절.
det.analysis: ✅ ①snowflakes: 원문 그대로. ✅ ②ash: 원문 그대로. ✅ ③resident: 원문 그대로. ❌ ④conceal: 원문은 highlight. 문제를 부각하려는 것이지 숨기려는 게 아님.
det.tip: highlight(부각하다) ↔ conceal(숨기다). Owen은 먼지 문제를 알리고 싶었음.

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a dumpster fire.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"Banksy의 작품은 아이가 진짜 눈송이를 잡고 있는 행복한 장면을 보여준다."

det.korean: 겉으로는 눈송이를 잡는 것처럼 보이지만, 실제로는 쓰레기통 불의 재를 향해 입을 벌리고 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ F: however로 반전. 눈송이가 아니라 재.
det.tip: 작품의 핵심: 겉(눈송이) vs 실제(재) 대비.

questions.passage: Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"Gary Owen은 아이들이 철강 공장에서 나오는 먼지 속에서 놀아 건강 위험에 처해 있다고 믿었다."

det.korean: Owen은 지역 철강 공장의 먼지로 인한 아이들의 건강 위험을 우려했다.
det.analysis: ✅ T: 'children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant' 그대로.
det.tip: Owen의 신념: 철강 공장 먼지 → 아이들 건강 위험.

questions.passage: According to the World Health Organization (WHO), about 93% of the world's children under 15 breathe in toxic air every day. In 2016, the WHO even estimated that about 600,000 children died from exposure to polluted air.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"WHO에 따르면 전 세계 15세 미만 아동의 약 50%만 유독한 공기를 마신다."

det.korean: 50%가 아니라 93%이다.
det.analysis: ✅ F: 원문은 about 93%. 50%는 사실과 다름.
det.tip: 수치 왜곡 주의. 93% ≠ 50%.

questions.passage: Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. det.korean: 약 60만 명의 아이들이 오염된 공기에 노출되어 사망했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①: 원문 그대로. 대기 오염 주제에 맞음. ❌ ②③④: 대기 오염과 무관한 사인.
det.tip: exposure to polluted air: 오염된 공기에 대한 노출.

questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 대기 오염 문제를 부각하는 Banksy의 예술

det.korean: Banksy의 예술이 대기 오염 문제를 부각하고 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③: 먼지 문제 부각을 위한 예술 작품. ❌ ①: 판매 방식 언급 없음. ❌ ②: 관광 무관. ❌ ④: 철강 산업 발전사 아님.
det.tip: 핵심: Banksy art + highlight dust problem = 예술을 통한 환경 문제 제기.

ch: Banksy는 처음으로 환경 메시지를 작품에 담았다
2010년 작품에는 성인이 나무를 심는 장면이 나온다

det.korean: 2010년 작품은 디트로이트의 공장 잔해에서 만들어졌다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④: remains of a plant in Detroit. ❌ ①: 런던이 아닌 디트로이트. ❌ ②: '이전에도(before)' 환경 메시지 포함. ❌ ③: 아이가 빨간 페인트 캔을 들고 있음.
det.tip: remains: 잔해. plant: 공장. Detroit: 미국 디트로이트.

questions.passage: Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant. Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 아이들은 호흡 속도가 빨라 더 많은 오염 물질을 흡입한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②pollutants: 원문 그대로. 빠른 호흡 → 더 많은 오염 물질. ❌ ①oxygen(산소): 오염 맥락 불일치. ❌ ③vitamins(비타민): 무관. ❌ ④proteins(단백질): 무관.
det.tip: 호흡 속도가 빠르면 공기 중 물질을 더 많이 들이마심. 오염 맥락 → pollutants.

questions.passage: Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. Owen believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks by playing in the dust coming from the local steel plant. Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution. Since they have faster breathing rates than adults, they breathe in more pollutants. questions.stem: 본문에서 찾아 다음 **영어** 단어를 찾아 쓰시오. "Gary Owen은 Port Talbot의 먼지 문제를 부각하기 위해 Banksy에게 예술 작품을 의뢰한 지역 __________이다."

det.korean: Gary Owen은 Port Talbot의 주민(resident)이다.
det.analysis: ✅ resident: 'a Port Talbot resident'에서 직접 찾기.
det.tip: resident: 주민, 거주자.

questions.passage: Banksy's art has included __________ messages before. For example, his 2010 artwork was created at the remains of a plant in Detroit. It showed a child with a can of red paint and the words, "I remember when all this was trees."
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

The company is committed to __________ (environment) protection and sustainable development.

det.korean: 그 회사는 환경 보호와 지속 가능한 발전에 전념하고 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ environmental: __________ protection → 명사 protection을 수식하는 형용사 필요. environment(명사) → environmental(형용사).
det.tip: environment(명사: 환경) → environmental(형용사: 환경의).

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, however, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a dumpster fire. Banksy was asked by Gary Owen, a Port Talbot resident, to create art that would highlight Port Talbot's dust problem. <u>He</u> believed that the area's children were facing serious health risks.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'He'가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 앞 문장의 Gary Owen이 Banksy에게 의뢰한 후, Owen이 아이들의 건강 위험을 믿었다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③Gary Owen: 바로 앞 문장에서 언급된 인물. Owen believed에 해당. ❌ ①Banksy: 예술가이지 건강 위험을 주장한 사람이 아님. ❌ ②the child: 작품 속 아이. ❌ ④resident: Owen과 같은 인물이지만 선지로 부적절(일반 명사).
det.tip: He = 가장 가까운 남성 인물. Gary Owen이 Banksy에게 의뢰 + 건강 위험 주장.

questions.passage: Secretive street artist Banksy designed another interesting piece of art, which appears on a concrete block garage in Port Talbot, Wales. It shows a child catching snowflakes with his mouth. When you look around the corner, __________, you realize that the child's mouth is open to ash coming from a dumpster fire.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 눈송이를 잡는 것처럼 보이지만, 그러나 실제로는 재를 향해 입을 벌리고 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④however: 겉모습(눈송이)과 실제(재) 대비. 반전. ❌ ①therefore(따라서): 인과 아님. ❌ ②similarly(마찬가지로): 유사 아님. ❌ ③in addition(또한): 추가 아님.
det.tip: however: 그러나. 앞뒤 내용의 반전/대조 신호.

questions.stem:
다음 한국어를 조건에 맞게 영작하시오.

"아이들은 대기 오염에 특히 무방비하다."

조건: Children, particularly, defenseless, air pollution을 사용할 것 (7단어)

accept: Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution

children are particularly defenseless against air pollution

det.analysis: ✅ Children(주어) + are(동사) + particularly(부사) + defenseless(형용사) + against(전치사) + air pollution(명사).
det.tip: defenseless against: ~에 대해 무방비한. particularly: 특히.

questions.ans: Children are particularly defenseless against air pollution

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: WHO에 따르면 15세 미만 아동의 약 93%가 유독한 공기를 마신다
